posts.content_md:
You might know that holographic film or stamping foil is very popular in flex printing and packaging field, but due to the joint line caused by "holographic shim", it caused lots of waste in printing, so mostly they have to use offset printer or very cost roto-grave printer. But our machine can produce any design of holographic film without any joint with our patent technology. If you are interested in our machine, contact with me. 

Best reagrds,Janny

[www.ymholotech.com](http://www.ymholotech.com)

posts.author: Ed Wesly
posts.content_md: Would you care to elaborate on how you make the seamless shims?

posts.author: ymholotech
posts.content_md:
this is no matte of seamless shim, we use two emboss system with special shim roller and match system,when film pass through the first shim roller, some area is blank since temp on shim roller is difference, and then pass through the second shim roller, the blank area will be embossed again. more details, please visit our website:[www.ymholotech.com](http://www.ymholotech.com)

Best regards

Janny
